250787cc772bd94bfc5922c1cda58103.overview: Two hit men walk into a diner asking for a man called "the Swede". When the killers find the Swede, he's expecting them and doesn't put up a fight. Since the Swede had a life insurance policy, an investigator, on a hunch, decides to look into the murder. As the Swede's past is laid bare, it comes to light that he was in love with a beautiful woman who may have lured him into pulling off a bank robbery overseen by another man.
250787cc772bd94bfc5922c1cda58103.tagline: She's a match for any mobster!

2519f8b547c279be9486f59e0b872c12.overview: Nothing is what it seems when a twisted one-night stand spirals into a serial killer’s vicious murder spree.

254bcd95a3b5432fa8483ede0435138b.overview: When veteran anchorman Howard Beale is forced to retire his 25-year post because of his age, he announces to viewers that he will kill himself during his farewell broadcast. Network executives rethink their decision when his fanatical tirade results in a spike in ratings.
254bcd95a3b5432fa8483ede0435138b.tagline: Television will never be the same.

25548a7144e00dcd125e0c039707870c.overview: In post-Sept. 11 Los Angeles, tensions erupt when the lives of a Brentwood housewife, her district attorney husband, a Persian shopkeeper, two cops, a pair of carjackers and a Korean couple converge during a 36-hour period.
25548a7144e00dcd125e0c039707870c.tagline: Moving at the speed of life, we are bound to collide with each other.

25596ea50af3b802125d8b70f2a7bb99.overview: A young Australian reporter tries to navigate the political turmoil of Indonesia during the rule of President Sukarno with the help of a diminutive photographer.
25596ea50af3b802125d8b70f2a7bb99.tagline: A love caught in the fire of revolution.

25c39e1535e6b88fce3d3998675dce69.overview: The British governor of a tiny island nation in the Caribbean Commonwealth finds his idyllic existence thrown into chaos when an American drilling company finds a huge source of natural mineral water there.

25ed21b1ecaaf3182018fc89d944a184.overview: Sex always gets in the way of friendships between men and women. At least, that's what Harry Burns believes. So when Harry meets Sally Albright and a deep friendship blossoms between them, Harry's determined not to let his attraction to Sally destroy it. But when a night of weakness ends in a morning of panic, can the pair avoid succumbing to Harry's fears by remaining friends and admitting they just might be the perfect match for each other?
25ed21b1ecaaf3182018fc89d944a184.tagline: Can two friends sleep together and still love each other in the morning?
